howItWorks.title: How to convert HTML to PDF
steps: Upload the HTML file you want to convert.
Click Convert to render it as a PDF.

items.q: Does this run JavaScript from my HTML file?
items.a: No — JavaScript is deliberately disabled during rendering, for both security and consistency. Static HTML and CSS render exactly as expected; content that only appears after a script runs will not.

items.q: What happens to images or stylesheets loaded from other websites?
items.a: External resources aren't fetched during conversion — they'll appear missing in the result, the same as a broken image. This is a deliberate security boundary, not a bug.

items.q: Is converting HTML to PDF free?
items.a: Yes, within the daily usage limits shown above.

items.q: Will my file be kept private?
items.a: Yes. Files are processed securely and automatically deleted after a short retention period.
